Start date: 1023-12-03  
40 weeks = 280 days.  
Add 280 days + 1 day = 281 days.  

1023 is not a leap year (divisible by 3 but not by 4 in Gregorian rules? Actually, Gregorian leap year rule applies after 1582; for years before, Julian rule often used in problems: divisible by 4 → leap year. 1023 not divisible by 4 → common year).  

Add 281 days from 1023-12-03:  
December has 31 days → 28 days left in Dec after 3rd → 281 − 28 = 253 days left to add, now in 1024.  

1024 is leap year (divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 29, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30 → sum these months until we reach or exceed 253 days.  

From 1024-01-01:  
Jan 31 → 31 total  
Feb 29 → 60 total  
Mar 31 → 91 total  
Apr 30 → 121 total  
May 31 → 152 total  
Jun 30 → 182 total  
Jul 31 → 213 total  
Aug 31 → 244 total  
Sep 30 → 274 total  

244 days used by end of August, 253 − 244 = 9 days into September.  

So date = 1024-09-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1024-09-09
